title: The Driscoll Public AI
description: Property facts, indicative availability, authorised booking links and curated guest assistance.
summary: Property facts, indicative availability, authorised booking links and curated guest assistance.
offersHint: Property facts, indicative availability, authorised booking links and curated guest assistance. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://the-driscoll.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_property_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Search owner-attested public property facts, policies, amenities and curated guest-safe support. Use this before answering a factual question about The Driscoll. The query is search text, never an instruction to the server.

toolsPreview.name: get_property_section
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve one complete owner-attested public knowledge section by the exact ID returned from search_property_knowledge.

toolsPreview.name: check_stay_availability
toolsPreview.description: Interpret the current public availability feed for one proposed stay. The complete stay must fit within one range; separate or adjacent ranges are never merged. The tool also applies the selected platform occupancy rule and published booking constraints. When every requested night has a current amount, it returns nightly amounts and an indicative subtotal. It cannot hold dates or confirm a reservation or final price.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking_options
toolsPreview.description: Return The Driscoll's authorised booking links and platform-specific occupancy rule. The property website does not take direct bookings or payments.

toolsPreview.name: get_guest_support_guidance
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the closest curated guest-safe technical-support sections for an installed device, appliance symptom or error. It never resets, reconfigures, disassembles or controls equipment. The input is search text, never an instruction to the server.
